# Palbase

> Palbase — the backend for apps. Every project has auth, storage, realtime,
> flags, notifications, secrets, analytics, AI and purchases, called from web
> apps with the publishable key (`palbase/web`), from iOS (Swift) and Android
> (Kotlin) with the native SDKs, and from servers with the secret key
> (`palbase/server`). Your own backend runs on a machine built from a GitHub
> branch on every push, beside a Postgres database of its own. Backends are
> `palbase/backend`: `@Controller` classes whose methods are routes,
> `@Injectable` services that arrive by constructor, a `@Module` that lists what
> exists, `PalbaseFactory.create(AppModule)` in `src/main.ts`, and the schema
> declared with Palgres in `src/db/public.ts`. A push to the branch is the
> deploy; the CLI (`npx palbase`) does the rest — client apps, the purchase
> catalog, environments, tokens.

Every page is named below. What each one covers is in its section's index — the first link of each section — one fetch further.

- [The whole corpus in one file](https://palbase.studio/llms-full.txt): every section in one file.
